verdict.rationale: Convertio is a cloud-based SaaS converter, and nothing in the evidence shows its own source code is published under an open license. The only related item is official API wrappers hosted on GitHub that users may "improve and modify". Those are client libraries, not the product's source, and no license is named, so they are adjacent at best.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
